title: Physics describes only the structure and dispositions of matter

statements.text: What physics tells about matter is abstract and formal, a matter of structure. It says how fundamental entities are disposed to behave, what mass and charge do, and leaves their categorical nature, what they are, undescribed.

sources.quote: there is a fundamental sense in which it is 'abstract', 'purely formal', merely a matter of 'structure', in Russell's words
Physics tells us much about the dispositions of fundamental natural entities, but leaves us completely in the dark about their categorical nature.
